@newPage: tooltip of the sidebar buttons that make a new page
@newTab: tooltip and name of the title bar button that opens a new tab
@splitView: a second page shown beside the main one: the title bar button that turns it on, and the empty side pane's heading
@closeSplitView: button that closes the second page shown beside the main one
@rowCount: how many rows a database has (title bar, sidebar tooltip); {count} is the number

sidebar.@hide: tooltip of the button that hides the sidebar
sidebar.@views: screen-reader name of the sidebar's list of places (Home, Assignments, Calendar…)

sections.@favorites: sidebar heading over the pages someone starred
sections.@courses: sidebar heading over the school courses (Biology, History)
sections.@databases: sidebar heading over the databases (tables of rows)
sections.@pages: sidebar heading over every page, in a tree

sidebar.@dueSoon: tooltip of the number beside Assignments; {count} is how many assignments are due in the next 7 days

dueSoonOverdue.one: {count} due within a week, some overdue
dueSoonOverdue.other: {count} due within a week, some overdue

sidebar.@dueSoonOverdue: the same tooltip when some of them are already late; {count} is how many are due in the next 7 days
sidebar.@eventsToday: tooltip of the number beside Calendar; {count} is how many calendar events are today
sidebar.@fileCount: tooltip of the number beside Files; {count} is how many files are in the library
sidebar.@cardsToStudy: tooltip of the number beside Flashcards; {count} is how many flashcards are due today
sidebar.@waiting: tooltip of the number beside Friends; {count} is how many friend requests and invitations to write together await an answer
sidebar.@openAssignments: tooltip of the number beside a course in the sidebar; {count} is how many of its assignments aren't done
sidebar.@addCourse: button shown under Courses when there are none yet
sidebar.@moveCourseUp: menu command on a course in the sidebar: moves it above the course before it (courses can also be dragged into order)
sidebar.@moveCourseDown: menu command on a course in the sidebar: moves it below the course after it
sidebar.@addDatabase: button shown under Databases when there are none yet
sidebar.@addPage: button shown under Pages when there are none yet
sidebar.@hideItem: right-click menu command on a sidebar item (Home, Courses…) that stops showing it in the sidebar
sidebar.@customize: right-click menu command that opens Settings, where the sidebar's items are turned on and off

hidden.@home: message after Home was hidden from the sidebar. “Settings → Sidebar” names the Sidebar section of Settings: use the same words as there. Same for the others in this group
hidden.home: Home is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.assignments: Assignments is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.calendar: Calendar is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.files: Files is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.flashcards: Flashcards is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.friends: Friends is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.galaxy: Galaxy is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.@galaxy: message after Galaxy was hidden from the sidebar, worded like the others in this group
hidden.favorites: Favorites is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.courses: Courses is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.databases: Databases is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.
hidden.tags: Tags is hidden. Settings → Sidebar shows it again.

titleBar.@showSidebar: tooltip of the title bar button that brings the hidden sidebar back
titleBar.@back: tooltip of the button that goes back to the previous page or view
titleBar.@forward: tooltip of the button that goes forward again after going back
titleBar.@breadcrumb: screen-reader name of the path to the open page shown in the title bar (Parent › Page)

live.@offline: the writing-together chip in the title bar: the connection is lost
live.@connecting: the writing-together chip: the connection is being made
live.@with: the writing-together chip: writing this page with someone, who is here now; {name} is their name or @username
live.@withPaused: the writing-together chip: the session is paused because nobody typed for a while; {name} is the other person's name or @username
live.@withAway: the writing-together chip: the other person isn't on the page right now; {name} is their name or @username
live.@withFriend: the writing-together chip, when the other person's name isn't known yet
live.@withFriendPaused: the writing-together chip, paused, when the other person's name isn't known yet
live.@withFriendAway: the writing-together chip, the other person away, when their name isn't known yet
live.@withYourFriend: the writing-together chip, when the other person is no longer among your friends, so their name isn't known: “Your friend” stands for them, like a name
live.@withYourFriendPaused: the writing-together chip, paused, when the other person is no longer among your friends, so their name isn't known
live.@withYourFriendAway: the writing-together chip, the other person away, when they're no longer among your friends, so their name isn't known
live.tip: Writing together: who's here, and End Session
live.@tip: tooltip of the writing-together chip: clicking it shows who's on the page and a button called End Session (use the same words as that button)

titleBar.@saving: title bar status while the page is being saved

created.@now: title bar status of a page nobody has typed in yet, made under a minute ago
created.@relative: title bar status of a page nobody has typed in yet; {when} is a relative time like “5 minutes ago” or “yesterday”
created.@date: title bar status of a page nobody has typed in yet, made a week ago or more; {date} is the date, like “Mar 3, 2025”

edited.@now: title bar status of a page changed under a minute ago
edited.@relative: title bar status of a page; {when} is a relative time like “5 minutes ago” or “yesterday”
edited.@date: title bar status of a page last changed a week ago or more; {date} is the date, like “Mar 3, 2025”

titleBar.@study: button that studies the open page's flashcards (a verb); {count} is how many are due or new, left out when none are
titleBar.@studyTip: tooltip of the Study button; {count} is how many flashcards the page has
titleBar.@addFavorite: tooltip of the star button: puts the page in the sidebar's Favorites
titleBar.@removeFavorite: tooltip of the star button on a page already in Favorites

appearance.@system: tooltip of the button that switches light and dark: now following the computer's setting
appearance.@dark: tooltip of the button that switches light and dark: now dark
appearance.@light: tooltip of the button that switches light and dark: now light

titleBar.@trashTip: tooltip of the Trash button; {count} is how many deleted pages, assignments, events and files are in it
titleBar.@badgeOverflow: the number on the Trash button when there are more than it shows; {max} is that number (99): “more than 99”

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.@label: screen-reader name of the row of tabs in the title bar
tabs.@liveSession: screen-reader name of the green dot on a tab whose page is being written together right now
tabs.@close: button on a tab that closes it

tree.@collapse: screen-reader name of the arrow that hides a page's subpages in the sidebar (a verb)
tree.@expand: screen-reader name of the arrow that shows a page's subpages in the sidebar (a verb)
tree.@addInside: tooltip of the + button on a sidebar page: makes a new page inside it

splitPane.label: Side page
splitPane.@label: screen-reader name of the second page shown beside the main one in split view
splitPane.dragHint: Drag to the left, or click, to open in the main view
splitPane.@dragHint: tooltip of the side page's title, at the right of the window
splitPane.@swapSides: button that switches the main page and the side page
splitPane.@openInMain: button that opens the side page in the main view and closes split view
splitPane.openOnLeft: This page is open on the left.
splitPane.@openOnLeft: in split view, when the side would show the same page as the main view
splitPane.pickTitle: Open a page beside this one
splitPane.@pickTitle: heading of the empty side pane in split view
splitPane.pickHint: Pick one below, or Alt+click any page in the sidebar or a link in your notes.
splitPane.@pickHint: under that heading; Alt is the keyboard key
splitPane.@findPage: placeholder of the search field that finds a page to show beside
splitPane.@noMatches: shown when no page's name has what was typed in that search field

splitDrop.label: Drop to open {title}
splitDrop.@label: screen-reader name of the area a dragged page can be dropped on; {title} is the page's name
splitDrop.@moveHere: label while dragging the side page onto the main view: it moves there
splitDrop.@openHere: label while dragging a page onto the main view: it opens there
splitDrop.@moveToSide: label while dragging the main page to the side of the window: it moves there
splitDrop.@openBeside: label while dragging a page to the side of the window: it opens beside the main page. The page's name follows it, after a dot

window.@minimize: Windows title bar button that minimizes the window: use Windows' own word for it
window.@maximize: Windows title bar button that makes the window fill the screen: use Windows' own word for it
window.@restore: screen-reader name of the same button on a maximized window: brings back its earlier size (not restoring from the Trash)
window.@restoreDown: tooltip of that button on a maximized window: use Windows' own words for it

toasts.@dismiss: screen-reader name of the × button that closes a message at the bottom of the window
